Gladly without lines
Sitting as and with
Thy divine injunction, give
To this space and time
What to conjunction ever lives.
Joined by the search are
Those who wait dearly, far
Going patience for hidden gems.
Send yet for this soul whose
Sole art is remembering,
Or, rather, forgetting to forget,
That all seeking is simply satisfied
In the Truth we are
And the Love we will beget
